Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Asaph_3: father of Zichri (1 Chronicles 9:15), singer (Ezra 2:41, Nehemiah 7:44)
Zerubbabel_2: returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7), son of Shealtiel (Ezra 3:2)
Jeshua_3: returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7)
Kadmiel_1: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (Ezra 2:40)
Hodaviah_5: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (Ezra 2:40)
Jozadak_1: father of Jeshua_3 who built the altar (Ezra 3:2)
